name: Tabernacles Feast Of
overview: The Feast of Tabernacles, also known as the Feast of Ingathering, is a divinely instituted celebration occurring on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and lasting seven days, as outlined in Leviticus 23:34-37. It marks a solemn assembly with holy convocations on the first and eighth days, during which no servile work is done and offerings made by fire are presented to the LORD. This feast commemorates the harvest's completion and the ingathering of crops at the year's end, emphasizing gratitude to God for His provision, as described in Exodus 23:16 and 34:22.
